data.title: Investment and cooperation offer to independent BPI Systems

actions.description: Adam proposes cash investment and a separately incorporated BPI Systems venture, retaining the BPI brand and independent management, with development cooperation from AION and distribution cooperation from Logix.

outcomes.description: Proposed BPI management retains product, licensing and specialist-support responsibility. AION engineers assist the C port, database and TUI implementation under agreement. The offer is not evidence of a completed equity transaction.
